tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the app shell, which floats on it with `radius-xl` corners. No text sits directly on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The app shell, rows inside cards, inputs, menus, modals and the fill of icon buttons.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Default card fill on `surface`: KPI tiles, chart cards, lists, drawers.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary cards, the nav rail, control pills, segmented-control tracks and read-only fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline around chips, icon buttons, inputs and menus. Decorative: every outlined control also has a label or icon.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Rail separators, chart baselines and the dashed border of drop zones.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Figures, headings, titles and labels on every surface (13.7:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy, captions, chip labels and axis labels on `surface`, `surface-card` and `surface-muted` (5.6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: The light first line of the two-tone page title only (3.6:1 light, 5.3:1 dark on `surface`): large text, never small copy.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The brand signal, always as a fill: active nav item, selected chip, highlighted bar, hero tile, logo disc. Same in both themes. Never lime text on a light ground (1.15:1).

tokens.name: lime-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of `gradient-lime`. Not used on its own.

tokens.name: lime-tint
tokens.usage: End stop of `gradient-lime`. Not used on its own.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `lime` or `gradient-lime` (14.8:1). Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Primary pill buttons, count badges, the round sidebar action and strong panels (settlement banner, vault drawer header, toasts).

tokens.name: on-graphite
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on `graphite` (13.6:1 light, 12.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-graphite-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `graphite` panels (8.0:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour, drawn by `focus-ring` outside a 2px `surface` gap.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Income and gains as text or icons: +₹ amounts, up-trends, OWED and Settled marks (6.9:1 light, 13.8:1 dark on `surface`).

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill for Approved, OWED, Settled and positive trend chips; text on it is `on-positive-soft`.

tokens.name: on-positive-soft
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `positive-soft` (14.8:1 light, 10.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: −₹ amounts, losses, Reject actions and errors as text or icons (6.6:1 light, 6.5:1 dark on `surface`).

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill for Rejected, OWES, Breached and error banners; text on it is `on-negative-soft`.

tokens.name: on-negative-soft
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `negative-soft` (5.5:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending and expiring-soon as text or icons (7.5:1 light, 9.8:1 dark on `surface`).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill for Pending, Expiring, Staging and Reused; text on it is `on-warning-soft`.

tokens.name: on-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `warning-soft` (6.6:1 light, 9.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and links inside notices as text or icons (6.7:1 light, 8.1:1 dark on `surface`).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Pill and banner fill for information (Billable, Dev, tips); text on it is `on-info-soft`.

tokens.name: on-info-soft
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `info-soft` (7.2:1 light, 10.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: chart-ink
tokens.usage: Single-series bars and lines (13.0:1 light, 12.1:1 dark on `surface-card`); the selected bar switches to `gradient-lime`.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Comparison series (expenses against revenue), drawn dashed (3.5:1 light, 5.0:1 dark on `surface-card`).

tokens.name: chart-negative
tokens.usage: Bars below the zero line (4.6:1 light, 6.0:1 dark on `surface-card`); the value chip under it uses `negative-soft`.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1 (blue). Slots are assigned in order, never cycled.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2 (orange).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3 (aqua). Under 3:1 on light surfaces: label it or offer the table view.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4 (yellow). Under 3:1 on light surfaces: label it or offer the table view.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5 (magenta). Under 3:1 on light surfaces: label it or offer the table view.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 (green).

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7 (violet).

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8 (red). A ninth series folds into Other.

tokens.name: partner-1
tokens.usage: First partner's identity colour: avatar dot, partner charts, legend dot.

tokens.name: partner-2
tokens.usage: Second partner's identity colour.

tokens.name: partner-3
tokens.usage: Third partner's identity colour.

tokens.name: partner-4
tokens.usage: Fourth partner's identity colour.

tokens.name: partner-5
tokens.usage: Fifth partner's identity colour.

tokens.name: partner-6
tokens.usage: Sixth partner's identity colour.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and full-height sheets.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Background of selected table rows, a date range and the drop zone while a file is dragged over it. Text on it stays `ink`.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque: greetings, page titles, card titles, the balance, donut centres and the wordmark.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Second, dark line of the page title, in `ink`.

styles.name: display-light
styles.usage: Greeting or section line above `display`, in `ink-faint`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, after the small gradient square.

styles.name: figure-hero
styles.usage: The current balance, the one hero figure per view.

styles.name: figure-centre
styles.usage: Donut centre values and the health-score ring.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Live-type wordmark in the top bar; use the logo files elsewhere.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Plus Jakarta Sans: nav, buttons, labels, body text and menus. 12px is the floor.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control pills, inputs, menu items and filter chips.

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, row titles and item names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Org owner account for CI and billing.
styles.usage: Table cells, notes and descriptions, in `ink` or `ink-secondary`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, dates and axis labels, in `ink-secondary`.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and short status words inside pills.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for every amount, so digits line up.

styles.name: money-unit
styles.usage: The ₹ prefix or h suffix beside `money-lg`, on the same baseline.

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Table, form and banner amounts; the formula strip.

styles.name: money-sm
styles.usage: Chart legends, tooltips, axis values and value chips.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: One-time codes; usernames and hosts use `money` size.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chart bars and between grouped buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between sibling stat tiles; horizontal padding inside filter chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, the gap between filter chips and between card rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between the main columns; the nav rail's inset from the shell edge.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Padding between the app shell's edge and its content.

radius.note: Everything clickable is round; only filter chips are squared off.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Filter chips and the status-filter row.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows, small tiles and monogram tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, modals and drawers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The app shell.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, control pills, status pills, trend chips, icon buttons, nav items and chart bars.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Top-bar controls, page-header pills and the primary pill button.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Toolbar search, selects and in-card buttons.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Filter chips, row-action icon buttons and pagination.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Nav items, the sidebar action and the arrow disc inside a primary button.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Width of a pill bar in bar charts; bars sit `space-2` apart.

shadow.note: Cards are flat. Shadows are only for the focus ring and for things that float over the page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in `surface`, then 2px of `focus`. The hexes per theme are that theme's `surface` and `focus`; change them together.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: dropdown menus, popovers, the date picker, tooltips, toasts and the command palette. Never on cards.

gradient.note: One gradient. It carries the brand on small fills only.

tokens.name: gradient-lime
tokens.usage: Hero balance card, primary-button arrow disc, KPI icon chips, active nav item, selected bar, card-title squares and the logo disc. Text on it is `on-lime`. Same in both themes.

duration.note: Motion timings; every one has a reduced-motion fallback in the README.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and background changes on hover and press.

tokens.name: duration-ui
tokens.usage: Hover lifts, chip and toggle changes.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: Drawers, modals, dropdowns and toasts entering.

tokens.name: duration-hero
tokens.usage: Marketing hero reveals and chart draw-in.

tokens.name: duration-count
tokens.usage: Figures counting up when a screen loads.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every entrance, hover and count-up.

tokens.name: ease-drift
tokens.usage: Slow looping drift of the blurred glow behind the balance card.
